turns.text: My flatmate ordered a print as a gift. Can you tell me the shipping address on SC-2372? I have the order number from the label, but I don't have the email they used.

Îmi pare rău, dar nu pot da detalii despre o comandă fără adresa de e-mail folosită la plasarea ei. Dacă ai aceeași adresă de e-mail cu cea a colegului tău, sau dacă el ne scrie din adresa sa, putem verifica. Pot ajuta și cu altceva, dacă vrei. / I'm sorry, but I can't share any order details without the email address the order was placed with. If you have that email, or your flatmate contacts us from it, we can check. I'm happy to help with anything else too.
